subject: LangChain Garden x Redwood — SDK onboarding & compatibility checklist
messages:
From: Ethan Ross <ethan@langchaingarden.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LangChain Garden x Redwood — SDK onboarding & compatibility checklist

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking a look at LangChain Garden. We're excited about the possibility of a tighter SDK integration with Redwood so our mutual customers can route model execution through Redwood's runtime while keeping the LangChain dev experience intact.

Attached is a short onboarding questionnaire (LCG_onboarding_questionnaire.pdf) to help us align on scope and references. High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm SDK-level compatibility: Python, Node, and the new async tracing hooks.
- Clarify which model variants and quantization profiles Redwood will expose to our connector (we typically test across 8k/16k contexts).
- Any constraints around streaming + function-calling semantics we should be aware of.

We can be flexible on timeline but would like an initial scoping sync next week if possible. Sandra (cc) will support the technical side.

Best,
Ethan Ross
Head of Integrations | LangChain Garden
ethan@langchaingarden.ai
www.langchaingarden.ai

Attachments: LCG_onboarding_questionnaire.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan@langchaingarden.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Sandra Liu <sandra@langchaingarden.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LangChain Garden x Redwood — SDK onboarding & compatibility checklist

Ethan / Sandra,

Appreciate the questionnaire — looks like a good starting point. Quick responses up front:
- We support Python and Node SDKs; our tracing hooks are available in the latest SDK v2.1. There is a short migration note for async iterator-based streams (I can paste it into the drive link).
- Model variants: we expose Llama-XX*, Mistral-*** variants, and a set of quantized profiles (int8/configured) — we'll share the compatibility matrix.
- Streaming + function-calling: supported; there are some edge cases when combining long-lived server streams with aggressive batching. We document recommended batching timeouts in the matrix.

Can we do a 45-min technical sync Tue 6 Apr between 10–12 PT? I'll invite Vivek (SDK PM) and Jordan (partners) — they'd like to review the tracehook contract and the SOW draft. Please share any example prompt sets you want us to test ahead of time.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Partner Lead, Strategic Integrations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

(On a logistics note: please include any compliance requirements (e.g., SOC 2 evidence) if you want us to preflight for enterprise customers.)
From: Ethan Ross <ethan@langchaingarden.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sandra Liu <sandra@langchaingarden.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LangChain Garden x Redwood — SDK onboarding & compatibility checklist

Thanks Kimberly — Tue 6 Apr 10:30 PT works.

Quick answers and attachments:
- I've exported a small matrix with our test vectors and the model/context expectations (redwood-sdk-compat-matrix.csv). It enumerates tokenization/encoding edge cases we hit with Llama-XX-16k.
- Draft SOW attached (draft-sow-LCG.pdf) with a tentative POC scope (SDK adapter + tracehook + a shared e2e test harness).
- Compliance: we'll need the basic SOC 2 and data residency notes; I can loop in our procurement lead after the sync.

Agenda proposal for the sync (45m):
  1) Quick intros & success criteria (5m)
  2) SDK surface + tracing contract (15m)
  3) Compatibility matrix walk-through (10m)
  4) Proposed POC scope & timeline (10m)
  5) Next steps / owners (5m)

Can you confirm whether Redwood will own the adapter in the Hosted API path vs. us maintaining a small client shim? We want to understand maintenance burden.

Looking forward — attaching the CSV and SOW.

Best,
Ethan

Attachments: redwood-sdk-compat-matrix.csv, draft-sow-LCG.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Ross <ethan@langchaingarden.ai>, Sandra Liu <sandra@langchaingarden.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 07:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LangChain Garden x Redwood — SDK onboarding & compatibility checklist

Kimberly / team — reviewing the files Ethan sent. A few technical notes to put on the agenda:

1) Tracehook contract: our current plan is to provide a lightweight tracing shim in the SDK that emits span metadata compatible with our telemetry collector. LangChain Garden will need to accept an opaque trace_id and propagate it through iterator-based streams. We should confirm headers and sampling semantics.

2) Batching + streaming: the compatibility CSV highlights where tokenizers produce different chunk boundaries; I want to run a quick local run to validate the suggested timeouts. If LangChain Garden wants us to own the adapter for Hosted API, we can, but it will be scoped as a Redwood-maintained integration with a minor version bump cadence and a runbook for rollback.

3) E2E test harness: propose adding a small set of canonical prompt/response pairs that exercise function calling + streaming + long-context >8k. We'll keep these in GitHub (see PR link) and run them as part of our compatibility CI.

Attaching a short note describing the trace expectations (trace-requirements.md).

If the partners agree, I suggest the following owners:
- Redwood SDK & tracehook: Redwood (Vivek, eng)
- LangChain Garden adapter & client shim: LangChain Garden (Ethan / Sandra)
- E2E harness: joint (GitHub PRs; automated CI)

Kimberly — if that's acceptable, please confirm on the Tue call and I'll prepare a short engineering checklist for the POC.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Product Manager, SDKs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: trace-requirements.md
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan@langchaingarden.ai>

Subject: Re: LangChain Garden x Redwood — SDK onboarding & compatibility checklist

Ethan / Sandra — all sounds good to me. Confirming Tue 6 Apr 10:30 PT (calendar invite sent).

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Ethan / Sandra: share any example prompt sets and confirm which model variants you want in the first POC (owner: LangChain Garden).
- Vivek: prepare engineering checklist + a short doc on trace header semantics (owner: Vivek).
- Kimberly / Jordan: draft client-maintenance RACI and update SOW with the Redwood-maintained adapter option (owner: Kimberly / Jordan).

I'll upload the meeting notes, the questionnaire, and the compatibility matrix to the shared Drive folder and add the calendar link. Looking forward — we should aim to have a scoped POC plan by end of next week.

Thanks everyone,
Kimberly Park

Redwood Inference
